recognize_zh: 中性球很多（像濃縮白血球層抹片），箭頭指的兩顆中性球裡各有一顆均質、淡紫色的大圓形物（LE body），把本身分葉核推到旁邊；在一群中性球中找到這種細胞，就是 LE 細胞。
features: Increased neutrophils, in keeping with a buffy-coat/LE cell preparation
Two neutrophils (arrows) containing a large round homogeneous pale-purple inclusion without chromatin structure
Neutrophil nuclear lobes compressed to the cell periphery around the inclusion
Other neutrophils show normal lobation and granulation
describe_en: Low-power view of a leukocyte-rich smear shows numerous segmented neutrophils. Two neutrophils (arrows) each contain a large, round, homogeneous pale-purple inclusion that lacks chromatin pattern and pushes the phagocyte's nucleus to the periphery. The remaining neutrophils are unremarkable, and the red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with LE cells.

ddx.vs: Tart cells contain an engulfed nucleus that keeps chromatin texture, usually inside a monocyte, rather than a structureless homogeneous body.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing an RBC or apoptotic cell
ddx.vs: Engulfed RBCs are pink-orange and apoptotic bodies are small, dark, and pyknotic, unlike the large pale-purple glassy LE body.
Overlapping cells have separate cell membranes and retained nuclear chromatin, not an inclusion within a single neutrophil cytoplasm.
